deals.title: £50 credit when you switch via a referral link
deals.detail: Octopus regularly tops the Citizens Advice service table and switching takes about ten minutes. Credit lands on your account after your first bill.

deals.title: £175 to switch your current account
deals.detail: Use the Current Account Switch Service, pay in £1,000 within three months and the bonus follows. Consistently one of the best-rated banks for service.

deals.title: £180 bank switch incentive
deals.detail: Switch with CASS, deposit £1,250 and log in to the app to qualify. Offers like this come and go — check the closing date before you start.

deals.title: Easy-access saver paying near the top of the market
deals.detail: Variable rate, FSCS protected, move money out whenever you like. Rates change fast — confirm the live rate before opening.

deals.title: Cash ISA with a market-leading variable rate
deals.detail: Tax-free interest, flexible withdrawals, FSCS protected. The headline rate can include a short-term bonus — read the terms.

deals.title: Full-fibre 150Mb from around £20/mo with no mid-contract rises
deals.detail: If you can get it in your building it beats most big-name deals. No setup fee on most plans and contracts without annual price hikes.

deals.title: Unlimited data SIM around £16/mo, one-month rolling
deals.detail: Runs on the Three network with no contract lock-in and no mid-contract price rises. Keep your number — switching takes one text.

deals.title: 25GB goodybag for £10/mo, no contract
deals.detail: Runs on O2. Most people on big-network contracts out of their minimum term can halve their bill with a SIM-only move like this.
